description: We are a team of mars enthusiast who want to build a game
summary:
NASA Space App Challenge 2026 - The Marstronauts

Build a junior astronaut mission trainer
Go to Mars and survive there on a space station for 1 year and find evidence of life forms – carry out research on Mars for new minerals, gasses and liquids. Study the climate and environment on Mars.

Game name: Life on Mars
Spaceship name: Shooting star
Space station name: Marsy McMars Face

Nature of the game:
D&D style game to deal with challenges and survive. Challenge arises – decide on action - throw dice to see what will happen depending on whether you selected a correct action or not (level of harm or benefits) – either succeed or need to deal with another challenge.
Aim – to survive, maintain the space station and return back to Earth

You can lose life power points if injured or sick or cold or hungry… When life power goes too low, the medic can save you with access to the correct medicine with a time limit of 2 minutes
You can get star dust for completing missions and can find it during exploration of Mars. This will help you regain lost life points. 
When you press on objects in the space station, it will tell you facts on what it is used for and how it works. 

Game plan:
Select a character
In a spaceship heading to Mars – will tell you facts about Mars and how to survive
Land on Mars
Find the Mars research station
How to survive in the research station – a day in the life of an astronaut on Mars
Dealing with challenges
Return back home
details:
•D&D style game for 2-7 players

• Aim: manage a research station on Mars, carry out missions, deal with challenges, survive and return to Earth.

Your vitality and survival depends on your stardust points
